---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature for Depsight
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you want to add.

## Motivation / Use Case

Explain why this feature would be useful. What problem does it solve? Who benefits from it?

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working. Include examples of CLI usage, output format, or API changes.

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or features? Why is this approach better?

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, mockups, or references here.

## Implementation Effort

(Optional) If you have an idea of the implementation effort:

- [ ] Small (less than a day)
- [ ] Medium (a few days)
- [ ] Large (a week or more)
